definitions.explanation: The main structural body of a vehicle, including cars, trains, and buses. Refers to the outer shell and frame, as distinct from the engine or interior.

examples.japanese: {車体|しゃたい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{傷|きず}→傷：02201_kizu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{付|つ}いて→付く：01960_tsuku⟧しまった。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{電車|でんしゃ}→電車：00522_densha⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧アルミニウム⟦{製|せい}→〜製：02001_sei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{軽|かる}い→軽い：00785_karui⟧{車体|しゃたい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{採用|さいよう}→採用：04563_saiyou⟧⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: This train uses a lightweight aluminum body.

notes:
{車体|しゃたい} refers to the outer body and frame of a vehicle, as distinct from the engine, wheels, or interior. It applies to any vehicle — cars, trains, buses, and trucks.

FORMS:
⟦{車|しゃ}→車：09874_sha⟧ (vehicle) + ⟦{体|たい}→体：09872_tai⟧ (body/structure).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {車体|しゃたい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{色|いろ}→色：00849_iro⟧: body color
- {車体|しゃたい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{傷|きず}→傷：02201_kizu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{付|つ}く→付く：01960_tsuku⟧: to get a scratch on the body
- {車体|しゃたい}{番号|ばんごう}: chassis number, vehicle identification number
- {車体|しゃたい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{磨|みが}く→磨く：02427_migaku⟧: to polish the car body
- {車体|しゃたい}⟦カバー→カバー：07812_kabaa⟧: car cover

SIMILAR WORDS:
{車体|しゃたい} is the physical body/frame. ⟦{車種|しゃしゅ}→車種：18800_shashu⟧ refers to the model or type of vehicle. ⟦{車両|しゃりょう}→車両：05297_sharyou⟧ means a vehicle as a whole unit, especially for trains.
